_meta.description: Draft data for the GPAI provider pack: a template for the publicly available summary of training content (Art. 53(1)(d)) and a map from the GPAI Code of Practice chapters to the Art. 53 / Art. 55 obligations.
_meta.note: Nothing here has been checked against the primary texts. Every row is low confidence and needs founder review.
